patch_description: Retry with the exact original text. Replace the slow 3-init exact coordinate descent (30s, stalls at 0.02) with a broad funnel: many deterministic seeds screened cheaply with a smooth softmin (LogSumExp) gradient ascent that updates all 13 points simultaneously via analytic gradients, then exact polish on the top candidates. This multi-start funnel is the approach that previously broke the 0.02 plateau.
